query: What was position of the man who served Prince Andrew from 1990-2001?

pipeline_result.response: The position held by Captain Robert Neil Blair during his tenure as Private Secretary and Treasurer to The Duke of York (Prince Andrew) from 1990 to 2001 was that of the Treasurer. This role involved managing the financial affairs of the Duke of York's household and estate.
